name: Electrical
description: Branch circuits in NM cable and in EMT with their conductors, straps and fittings; receptacles, switches and boxes; light fixtures; panelboards; data outlets and Cat 6 runs. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: NFPA 70, National Electrical Code, Article 334 Nonmetallic-Sheathed Cable (334.30 securing and supporting)
NFPA 70, National Electrical Code, Article 300 General Requirements for Wiring Methods (300.14 free conductor at outlets)
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
NFPA 70, National Electrical Code, Article 358 Electrical Metallic Tubing (358.30 securing and supporting)
NFPA 70, National Electrical Code, Article 314 Outlet, Device, Pull, and Junction Boxes
ANSI/TIA-568, Commercial Building Telecommunications Cabling Standard
